notes: Endpoints: the committed swagger (templates/swagger/v1-swagger.generated.json, generated from swagger comments) for /api/v1, plus 11 routes only the code has, read in it (swagger, nodeinfo and activitypub behind settings, the GitHub-compatible commits/{sha}, the per-repo markup/markdown, contents-ext, artifact zip/raw, GET admin user orgs); scope routers/api/v1/. Every API route is registered inside closures m.Group("/x", func() {...}) on the same receiver of Routes(), and routers/init.go mounts that router at /api/v1 (r.Mount("/api/v1", apiv1.Routes())); helpers (addActionsRoutes, a closure assigned to a variable, and addProjectRoutes) take the router as a parameter and are called inside several groups. Categories, from a code-derived list of the closures (one per route, the most specific fix it needs): route-chain = m.Combo("/x").Get(h).Put(h) (verbs chained on a path builder, also inside the helpers); custom-registrar = g.MatchPath("GET", "/<ref:*>/status", h) (3); prefix-scope-and-file: GET archive/{archive} and pulls/{index}.{diffType}, whose ".{diffType}" pattern gitea joins to the group without a slash (extracted as /pulls/{index}/.{diffType}). Until H2b item 2 step 2 (2026-10-16) no API route came out with its /api/v1 (prefix-other-file 247, router-as-param 78). Precision sample over the whole repo: web.go, packages and api routes, all with the closure prefix lost. Calls: three route registrations with a spread handler (routes.Get("/metrics", append(mid, h)...)) come out as outbound calls (route-taken-for-call); the three captcha verifications are right. The frontend calls go through verb-named wrappers GET(url)/POST(url) from web_src/js/modules/fetch.ts (client-wrapper); expected calls = those with a literal path after appSubUrl (the ones built on a link read from the page are runtime URLs, H2-D5). Since the v2 cheap fixes (2026-10-15): a spread handler list (append(mid, h)...) makes a route, not a call.
